date_note: Date of Rokkatei's notice; the altered payment screen was live from 21 Oct 21:00 to 18 Nov 11:00 (times as in the notice).
title: Rokkatei online shop payment screen altered; about 8,000 card cases may have leaked, one misuse confirmed
summary: Rokkatei says it found on 18 November that its online shop's payment-screen program had been altered by a third party; card details entered between 21 October 21:00 and 18 November 11:00 may have leaked, about 8,000 cases confirmed so far; the shop is suspended. A 21 November notice adds that names, postal addresses, phone numbers and emails may also have leaked, and that a customer reported one card misuse on 20 November.
plain: Japanese confectioner Rokkatei says its web shop's payment page was tampered with, so card and contact details typed in over about four weeks may have leaked; one card has been misused.
exec: A retailer's checkout was altered, putting about 8,000 cases of card details (the company's count, unit not specified) at risk and the shop offline.
action: Rokkatei advises customers who paid by card on its online shop between 21 October and 18 November to check card statements, contact their card issuer and ask it to reissue the card.

evidence.quote: 現時点で確認されている件数：約8,000件

validation.note: Rokkatei's own notices (primary; second report of 21 Nov read in full on 21 Nov) and Cybersecurity.com (Japan), which relays them; count is the company's 'confirmed so far' figure from the first report, not restated in the second.

review.note: Notice gives about 8,000 as cases, confirmed so far; exec said customers' card details; now says about 8,000 cases, unit not specified. Date, window, data items, suspension match the notice
